verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair automation-depth question for a plugin and skills ecosystem, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents performing one action across many items at once. The cited items cover installing plugins, packaging skills with optional scripts, and per-service integrations such as Gmail, Drive and Slack; these are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
